_comment: Private dashboard page. Not in nav, not in the sitemap, noindex/nofollow — reachable only by typing the URL. It holds no secrets: it is a set of links and an optional embedded dashboard, so a stray visitor learns nothing.
metaDescription: Private operations page for candicechudvm.com: analytics dashboards, build status and deployment shortcuts.
intro: Private operations page. Not linked from anywhere, not indexed, not in the sitemap. Bookmark it.

embed._comment: Paste a shareable dashboard URL to see live numbers right here. GoatCounter: Settings → Site settings → Public access. Plausible: Site settings → Visibility → shared link. Cloudflare and GA4 cannot be embedded — use their dashboard links below instead.
embed.title: Live traffic dashboard

links.label: Cloudflare Web Analytics
links.note: Page views, referrers, visitor countries, device and browser mix. Free, cookie-free, no consent banner.

links.label: Google Search Console
links.note: What people searched before clicking, which pages rank, and any indexing problems. Add both candicechudvm.com and the sitemap.

links.label: Bing Webmaster Tools
links.note: The same for Bing — which also feeds several AI answer engines.

links.label: GitHub Actions runs
links.note: Every deploy, with the build and validation log. A red run means the live site is still the previous version.

checklist: Pick a provider in _data/site.json → analytics.provider and paste its id.
Rebuild and deploy: node _build/build.mjs, then commit and push.
Open the site in a private window, then confirm the visit appears in the dashboard.
In Search Console, submit https://candicechudvm.com/sitemap.xml once. It re-reads it automatically after that.
Optional: paste a shared dashboard URL into _data/backstage.json → embed.url to see the numbers on this page.
privacyNote: Cloudflare, Plausible, Umami and GoatCounter are all cookie-free and collect no personal data, so no consent banner is required. GA4 does set cookies — if you choose it, a privacy notice becomes necessary.
